lines.text: A broke Canadian man turned one red paperclip into a free two-story house.
And it only took him fourteen trades.
In two thousand five, Kyle posted a red paperclip on Craigslist.
He traded the clip for a fish-shaped pen.
Then the pen for a doorknob, and the knob for a camp stove.
Trade after trade, he leveled up to a generator, then a snowmobile.
Next came a recording contract, an afternoon with a rockstar, and a snow globe.
A Hollywood director traded a paid movie role for the snow globe.
Finally, a town offered him a real house for that movie role.
Kyle moved in rent-free without spending a single dollar.
